new_local_sources.name: FTP-1
key_findings: README describes FTP-1 as a generalist foundation tactile policy across sensors and embodiments.
README links model checkpoints for ftp1_pretrain_v0426_50kstep and ftp1_univtac_finetune on HuggingFace and ModelScope.
README says FTP-1 is based on OpenPI and uses zarr data for fine-tuning, with UniVTAC as an example domain.
README inference API expects tactile inputs shaped as time x function areas x image tensors plus tactile sensor labels such as GelSightMini.
new_local_sources.gate_effect: Not a Newton-native infant checkpoint and not Gate 00F evidence. It is a serious future policy/checkpoint baseline after dense tactile semantics and environment gates pass.

new_local_sources.name: AnyTouch2
key_findings: README describes AnyTouch 2 as ICLR 2026 general optical tactile representation learning for dynamic tactile perception.
README links an AnyTouch2 model checkpoint on HuggingFace and ToucHD/Sparsh evaluation datasets.
README notes checkpoint/data access may require completing HuggingFace forms.
Quick start script is still marked coming soon.
new_local_sources.gate_effect: Not a controller and not Gate 00F official simulation sanity. It is a future tactile encoder/comparison reference after official tactile channels are validated.

new_local_sources.name: Official IsaacLab main sparse TacSL source
new_local_sources.role: official Isaac Lab TacSL visuo-tactile sensor source
key_findings: Official docs describe a TacSL-integrated visuo-tactile sensor that outputs tactile RGB images, force field distributions, and intermediate tactile measurements.
The demo entrypoint is scripts/demos/sensors/tacsl_sensor.py with --use_tactile_rgb, --use_tactile_ff, --normal_contact_stiffness, --tangential_stiffness, --friction_coefficient, and --save_viz.
VisuoTactileSensorData exposes tactile_depth_image, tactile_rgb_image, tactile_points_pos_w, tactile_points_quat_w, penetration_depth, tactile_normal_force, and tactile_shear_force.
VisuoTactileSensorCfg includes normal_contact_stiffness, friction_coefficient, tangential_stiffness, contact_object_prim_path_expr, tactile_array_size, and tactile_margin.
The force field path computes normal force from penetration depth and shear force from tangential velocity/stiffness/friction, then writes tactile_normal_force and tactile_shear_force.
new_local_sources.gate_effect: This is a stronger official TacSL semantic reference than the earlier generic UM-ARM-Lab/IsaacLabTactile clone, but it still requires official Isaac Lab environment/assets and compute-side sanity before it can clear Gate 00F.
